authoring.note: Jan Evertsenstraat 59-89 (odd side). The balcony-slot row (evertsen-1926-balcony-slot): French-door slots with stacked balconettes paired at every other party wall, a wide window touching each door, the party-wall windows completed by mirrored neighbours; glass block over the canopy on 59-73, painted sign panels on 75-89.
